title: Troubleshooting Login Loops, MFA Failures, and SSO Redirect Issues
content_summary: Covers common authentication errors including login loops, premature token expiration, and MFA rejections, typically caused by configuration mismatches in Permission Engine or LDAP Connector.
content_body: When users report login loops or invalid token errors, first verify that the federation metadata in the customer's identity provider matches the configuration in the Permission Engine. Ensure the LDAP Connector is using supported authentication flows and not an unsupported configuration. Check if password reset emails are being blocked by strict spam filters, which can mimic a missing email symptom. Most of these issues are resolved through configuration changes or customer education on proper SSO setup. Review the operator's recent changes to the authentication policy if the issue appeared suddenly.

title: Handling Security Alerts for Suspicious Login Activity and Brute Force Attempts
content_summary: Guidance on responding to security alerts such as account lockouts, unexpected logouts, and certificate warnings related to OAuth Service operations.
content_body: When encountering account lockouts or elevated privilege alerts, determine if the root cause is operator error or a known product limitation in the OAuth Service. If credentials were rotated but not propagated, perform a credential rotation to synchronize access tokens. Check for certificate expired warnings that may cause unexpected logout behavior. Some security flags are part of the intended 'as designed' behavior and require no fix, but an access review should be completed to confirm. Apply configuration changes to adjust threshold sensitivities if false positives persist.

title: Resolving Data Residency Violations and Audit Log Gaps in Tax Calculator
content_summary: Specific steps for addressing data residency flag mismatches and missing consent records, often due to data quality issues or product limitations.
content_body: Identify the specific audit log gap or data residency flag mismatch using the Tax Calculator's diagnostic tools. If the issue stems from a known product limitation regarding consent record retention, apply the known-issue workaround documented in the release notes. For data quality issues causing missing records, execute the provided data repair script to reconcile the discrepancies. Manual reconciliation may be required for complex historical data mismatches. Verify if the behavior is 'as designed' for legacy data structures before escalating.

title: Fixing UI Rendering Issues and Broken Workflow Steps in Config Manager
content_summary: Troubleshooting steps for UI elements not rendering, broken pagination, or incorrect localized text, often caused by race conditions or product limitations.
content_body: 1. Check if the UI element failure occurs during rapid state changes, which indicates a race condition. 2. Verify if the localized text error persists after clearing the browser cache, as stale assets may cause display issues. 3. If pagination is broken specifically in large datasets, this may be a known product limitation; apply the known-issue workaround involving server-side pagination. 4. For unresolved rendering defects, escalate to engineering for a product patch. 5. Confirm if the behavior is 'as designed' for deprecated interface modes.

title: Common Authentication Failures: Login Loops, Session Expiration, and Password Reset Issues
content_summary: Broad troubleshooting for login failures, SSO redirect loops, and session expiration issues linked to Active Directory Sync configurations and certificate states.
content_body: Start by checking for expired certificates in the Active Directory Sync configuration, which often cause login failures and HTTP 401 errors. If users report that MFA prompts are not appearing, verify the identity provider status for outages. Customer configuration errors in the session timeout settings can lead to unexpected session expiration. Reset the token and session cache to clear transient authentication states. Engage the vendor if the issue is traced to an identity provider outage, and provide customer education on proper session management.

title: Diagnosing Access Denied Errors and Permission Propagation Delays
content_summary: Addresses HTTP 403 errors, role application failures, and incorrect data visibility in the SSO Integration Module due to configuration or review errors.
content_body: When users see HTTP 403 errors or incorrect data, check for delays in permission propagation within the SSO Integration Module. Operator errors during role assignment often result in the 'role not applied' symptom. Conduct an access review to identify and correct improper privilege grants that may cause 'access granted incorrectly' alerts. Update permissions manually if the automatic propagation fails. Ensure documentation is corrected if the root cause was a misunderstanding of the permission hierarchy.

title: Resolving Billing Discrepancies, Proration Errors, and Payment Processing Stalls
content_summary: General guidance for handling payment declines, stuck processing states, and incorrect tax amounts in the Invoice Service and Billing Disputes Handler.
content_body: Investigate payment declines by checking for third-party service failures in the payment gateway. If a refund is not processed or a duplicate charge is reported, verify the invoice data for quality issues. Apply a workaround if the proration error is due to a known calculation bug in the Billing Disputes Handler. Use data repair scripts to correct tax amounts or invoice discrepancies. Engage the vendor for complex third-party failures and perform manual reconciliation for stuck payments.

title: Legacy Process for Correcting Proration Errors in Subscription Manager
content_summary: Outdated guidance for handling incorrect proration and refund delays using manual reconciliation and data scripts before the new billing engine update.
content_body: To correct proration errors, first generate a report in Report Builder to identify the specific invoice lines. Manually adjust the tax amount using the legacy credit memo tool if the refund is not reflected. Run the data repair script on the Subscription Manager database to update the pro-rated values. Note that this process assumes the pre-2023 billing engine architecture. If the issue persists, engage the vendor for manual reconciliation as automated fixes were not available in this version.

title: Fixing Federation Failures and SSO Error Pages with Expired Certificates
content_summary: Specific resolution steps for login failures and SSO error pages caused by expired certificates in the Permission Engine and SSO Integration Module.
content_body: 1. Confirm the presence of an expired certificate in the federation metadata. 2. Renew the certificate in the identity provider and upload the new public key to the SSO Integration Module. 3. Verify that the MFA prompt is appearing after the certificate renewal to ensure successful authentication. 4. If the error persists, check for operator error in the certificate binding settings. 5. Complete an access review to ensure no user permissions were revoked during the certificate rotation process.

title: Handling Informational Requests and Ambiguous Service Issues
content_summary: Procedure for managing tickets with insufficient information, such as application crashes or data mismatches, often resolved by customer education or closing duplicates.
content_body: When receiving a ticket with vague symptoms like 'application crash' or 'data mismatch' without logs, request additional information from the customer. If the issue stems from operator error in the request syntax, provide customer education on the correct usage. Perform an access review if the 'service unresponsive' claim is related to permission visibility. Close the ticket as a duplicate if the same informational request has been submitted by other users. Apply configuration changes only if the root cause is clearly identified as a settings mismatch.

title: Resolving Duplicate Accounts from Onboarding Wizard Bulk Import
content_summary: This article details how to fix cases where the Onboarding Wizard's bulk import creates duplicate accounts, leaving the sync stuck. It covers using the Chargeback Handler to reverse billing and running a data repair script.
content_body: When a bulk import in the Onboarding Wizard fails partially, it often leaves duplicate accounts that cause the user sync to get stuck. Check for operator errors in the source CSV, specifically duplicate identifiers that bypassed initial validation. To resolve this, run the standard data repair script to merge the duplicate profiles. Next, use the Chargeback Handler to reverse any double billing charges generated by the duplicates. Finally, complete an access review to ensure the correct user profile was retained.

title: Troubleshooting Intermittent 5xx Errors and Partial Outages in API Gateway and Queue Manager
content_summary: Addresses root causes and remediation steps for partial outages caused by resource exhaustion, dependency failures, or insufficient monitoring in API Gateway and Queue Manager environments.
content_body: When experiencing intermittent 5xx errors or partial outages, check for resource exhaustion and dependency failures as the primary root causes. Verify that health checks are not failing due to application crashes or pods restarting repeatedly. Resolve these issues by increasing capacity, remediating failed dependencies, or adjusting rate limits. Ensure adequate monitoring and alerting is in place, and engage the vendor if the issue persists.

title: Fixing corrupted export files from Subscription Manager due to migration defects
content_summary: Addresses scenarios where Subscription Manager exports contain stale data, duplicates, or corruption following a data migration. Explains how to verify the source defect and apply repair scripts.
content_body: When an export from Subscription Manager appears corrupted, first check if the issue coincided with a recent data migration; migration defects often leave behind stale or duplicate records. Verify the integrity by comparing record counts and checksums against the pre-migration baseline. If duplicates are confirmed, execute the standard data repair script provided by the engineering team to deduplicate the dataset. For persistent corruption, perform a full data re-sync from the upstream source of truth. If automated repairs fail, manual reconciliation of the affected subscription IDs may be necessary.

title: Troubleshooting Intermittent HTTP 504 and Timeouts in Fee Analyzer Batch Jobs
content_summary: Addresses intermittent batch job failures characterized by database query timeouts and HTTP 504 errors, typically caused by third-party service instability or database contention.
content_body: If Fee Analyzer batch jobs are failing intermittently with HTTP 504 errors, first check the application logs for specific database query timeout messages. These issues are often rooted in database contention or upstream third-party service failures that stall the processing queue. To resolve this, engage the vendor if third-party APIs are unresponsive, and simultaneously request a capacity increase for the database resources. Long-term fixes usually involve database optimization, such as adding indexes or splitting large queries, to prevent recurring timeouts during peak loads.

title: Troubleshooting Notification Hub Timeouts Due to Third-Party Dependency Failures
content_summary: Addresses timeouts in Notification Hub and KPI Tracker caused by upstream third-party API unavailability or dependency version conflicts.
content_body: When Notification Hub or KPI Tracker reports timeouts, first check the status of external dependencies like SMS gateways or email providers. Version conflicts in these libraries often cause silent failures that manifest as generic timeout errors. Verify the current version of the third-party client against the vendor's compatibility matrix. If a conflict is found, upgrade the dependency or apply a temporary retry logic workaround. Engage the vendor support team if the service itself is experiencing intermittent downtime.

title: Resolving Data Export Service Delays and Timeouts
content_summary: Guidance on diagnosing and resolving performance issues with the Data Export Service when caused by database contention, resource exhaustion, or capacity limitations.
content_body: When Data Export Service queries time out or replication lag increases, check for database deadlocks, connection pool exhaustion, and index corruption. These symptoms often indicate resource exhaustion or capacity limitations under heavy load. Start by monitoring active database queries and index health; if contention is high, consider running index rebuilds or optimizing queries. For persistent issues, a capacity increase or infrastructure replacement may be required to handle the load, while rate limit adjustments can help manage concurrent export requests.

title: Troubleshooting RBAC and Conditional Access Issues in MFA Manager and Invoice Service
content_summary: Guidance for resolving unexpected permission denials, privilege escalation, or data visibility errors related to Role-Based Access Control and conditional access policies. Note that this article references the legacy 'Access Rules' tab structure which has been deprecated in favor of the new 'Policy Engine' interface.
content_body: When users report seeing wrong tenant data or receiving HTTP 401 errors, first verify the current role assignments within the legacy 'Access Rules' tab of MFA Manager. Ensure that conditional access blocks are not inadvertently overriding specific invoice service permissions due to outdated group mappings. Most incidents are resolved by correcting customer configuration errors or completing a pending access review that was skipped during recent updates. Educate stakeholders on the difference between immediate access grants and scheduled privilege reviews to prevent future misapplication.

title: Resolving HTTP 403 and Data Visibility Errors in Permission Engine RBAC
content_summary: This article addresses common RBAC configuration issues leading to HTTP 403 errors or incorrect data visibility. It guides support agents through verifying operator permissions and applying necessary policy corrections.
content_body: When a user reports an HTTP 403 error or sees incorrect data, first check the current role assignment in the Permission Engine console. These issues are frequently caused by operator errors where permissions were manually altered incorrectly or not updated after role changes. To resolve, perform an access review to identify the specific mismatched permission set. Apply the correct policy update or configuration change to align the user's access with their intended role. Finally, confirm with the user that data visibility is restored and the 403 errors have ceased.

title: SSO Integration Module: Handling Token Acquisition and Session Issues
content_summary: This article provides a broad overview of common troubleshooting steps for token acquisition failures, session expirations, and credential issues within the SSO Integration Module.
content_body: When users report login failures or missing MFA prompts, first verify that the Identity Provider (IdP) is online and responding. Check for federation metadata mismatches by comparing the current metadata hash against the version stored in the SSO configuration. Unexpected session expirations are often caused by token handling bugs or incorrect clock skew settings between servers. If password reset emails are missing, confirm that the SMTP relay is functioning and that the reset link TTL is not set too low. Resolution typically involves a configuration change, applying a product patch for known token bugs, or engaging the vendor for IdP-specific outages.

title: Addressing API Gateway and Webhook Engine Performance Degradation
content_summary: Guidance for troubleshooting intermittent latency, HTTP 504 errors, and slow responses across the API Gateway and Webhook Engine due to resource exhaustion or third-party dependencies.
content_body: When users report slow mobile app performance or high latency with HTTP 504 errors, first check for resource exhaustion indicators like CPU usage spikes or database query timeouts. If resource limits are hit, a capacity increase or rate limit adjustment on the API Gateway may be necessary. For issues stemming from third-party service failures, engage the vendor directly to resolve upstream bottlenecks. Some known product limitations may require implementing a specific workaround, such as batching requests or extending timeouts, where no permanent fix is immediately available. If the behavior matches documented as-designed patterns, confirm with stakeholders that no fix is required.

title: Troubleshooting TLS Connectivity Failures in Subscription Manager
content_summary: Addresses connection resets and refused errors in Subscription Manager caused by firewall misconfigurations or expired certificates.
content_body: Verify that the client can resolve the Subscription Manager endpoint via DNS. If DNS fails, check local resolver settings. If the connection is refused or reset, inspect the firewall rules to ensure port 443 is open for outbound traffic. If connectivity is established but the handshake fails, check the expiration date of the client certificate. Renew the certificate and update the firewall rule if necessary to restore service.

title: Compliance Audit Failures in OAuth Service
content_summary: Addresses common causes for incomplete compliance reports, missing consent records, and audit log gaps within the OAuth Service, focusing on configuration errors and data quality issues.
content_body: When audit logs appear incomplete or consent records are missing, first verify that the data residency flags align with the regulatory reporting configuration. These symptoms often stem from operator errors in setting retention policies or known product limitations in log propagation. A manual reconciliation process is typically required to identify the specific gap, followed by a configuration change or data repair script to enforce the correct retention rules. If the discrepancy is due to a known issue, apply the documented workaround to prevent future reporting errors.

title: Troubleshooting SSO Redirect Loops and MFA Rejections in Identity Vault
content_summary: Addresses persistent SSO redirect loops and rejected MFA codes caused by federation metadata mismatches or identity provider outages.
content_body: When users report SSO redirect loops or MFA rejections, first verify the current federation metadata against the identity provider's endpoint. Check for known outages at the IdP side, as this is a frequent root cause. If metadata is stale, perform a token/session reset to clear cached assertions. For operator-induced configuration errors, engage the vendor if self-service resets do not resolve the loop. Finally, document the fix and update the access review records to prevent recurrence.

title: Capacity / Scaling
content_summary: Capacity / Scaling
content_body: Check the resource usage metrics for both the Session Controller and Wallet Service to identify any CPU or memory usage spikes. These spikes are often caused by resource exhaustion or a capacity limitation within the current infrastructure configuration. Review the rate limit settings to ensure they are not misconfigured, as this can lead to throttling and quota exceeded errors. To resolve the issue, consider a capacity increase or adjust the rate limits to better match the current traffic load. If the issue persists, evaluate whether an infrastructure replacement is necessary to support higher demand.

title: Workaround for Deprecated Vendor API in Cohort Builder
content_summary: Addresses timeouts in Cohort Builder caused by the deprecated vendor API, outlining temporary workarounds and vendor engagement steps.
content_body: When Cohort Builder fails to generate segments due to upstream dependency timeouts, check the status of the legacy vendor API endpoint. This issue typically stems from the vendor deprecating the old API version without prior notice. As an immediate workaround, switch to the cached data source available in the admin settings. Simultaneously, open a priority ticket with the vendor to confirm the deprecation timeline. Long-term resolution requires migrating to the new API integration released in the latest update.

title: Troubleshooting MFA and SSO Session Issues
content_summary: Overview of common causes for SSO errors, login loops, and MFA failures, including certificate expiration and configuration mismatches.
content_body: Check for expired certificates on the identity provider and verify that the MFA Manager configuration supports the client's browser version. Login loops often result from unsupported session configurations or operator errors during setup. Renewing certificates and correcting configuration parameters usually resolves these issues. Educate customers on proper account linking to prevent duplicate account creation.

title: Troubleshooting Missing Consent Records in Data Pipeline Audit Logs
content_summary: Addresses audit log gaps and data residency flags related to missing consent records when using the OAuth Service and Data Pipeline.
content_body: If you encounter incomplete compliance reports or mismatched residency flags, verify that the OAuth Service configuration aligns with the supported regions for your Data Pipeline. Often, these gaps stem from unsupported configurations where consent scopes were not properly mapped during initial setup. To resolve this, update your pipeline settings to ensure consent records are explicitly logged and forwarded to the compliance store. Additionally, enable real-time monitoring alerts for consent record ingestion to catch future discrepancies early. Customer education on proper scope selection during OAuth integration is also recommended to prevent recurring issues.

title: Troubleshooting Chat Widget Configuration Not Applying
content_summary: Addresses issues where configuration changes to the Chat Widget, such as feature flags or integration settings, fail to take effect. This article guides agents through identifying configuration drift and correcting unsupported or customer-side errors.
content_body: When a customer reports that Chat Widget configurations are not applying, first verify that the feature flag is supported in their specific subscription tier. Check for configuration drift by comparing the live settings against the intended state in the admin panel. Most often, these issues stem from unsupported combinations of settings or simple syntax errors in custom integrations. Resolve the issue by guiding the customer to the correct configuration format or applying a manual configuration change. If the root cause is ambiguous, consult the latest documentation to ensure the guidance provided is current.

title: Addressing Capacity and Scaling Issues in Secret Store and Deploy Manager
content_summary: General guidance for handling resource exhaustion, rate limits, and scaling bottlenecks in Secret Store and Deploy Manager environments.
content_body: When experiencing slow responses or rate limit exceeded errors, first check current CPU and memory usage metrics for spikes that may indicate resource exhaustion. Insufficient capacity planning often leads to these symptoms, particularly during peak deployment or secret retrieval windows. Adjust rate limits in configuration files if the issue is isolated to specific API endpoints rather than global infrastructure limits. For persistent memory leaks or capacity limits, consider an infrastructure replacement or a significant capacity increase rather than temporary configuration tweaks. Note that older scaling procedures may not account for dynamic load balancing introduced in recent platform updates.

title: Troubleshooting Bulk Import Failures and Duplicate Accounts in Identity Vault
content_summary: Addresses scenarios where bulk provisioning jobs fail completely or create duplicate accounts due to synchronization delays or data quality issues. Provides steps for dependency remediation, data repair, and manual reconciliation.
content_body:
1. Verify that all upstream data sources are healthy and synchronized to rule out dependency failures.
2. Check the import logs for specific data quality errors such as malformed attributes or duplicate identifiers that may have caused partial or full job failure.
3. If duplicates are identified, run the standard data repair script to merge conflicting records and clear orphaned entries.
4. For persistent synchronization delays, manually reconcile the affected accounts against the source of truth and escalate to vendor support if the issue continues.

title: Chargeback Handler API Schema Errors and Webhook Failures
content_summary: Addresses issues where the Chargeback Handler API returns empty responses or fails to trigger webhooks due to schema mismatches or breaking contract changes.
content_body: When users report empty API responses or missed webhooks in the Chargeback Handler, check for recent schema mismatches or breaking API contract changes. These issues often arise when the client implementation has not been updated to reflect the latest API definition. Resolve by performing a schema migration to align the client with the current API contract. If a breaking change was introduced unintentionally, apply an API contract fix to restore backward compatibility.

title: Legacy Guide: Troubleshooting Third-Party Notification Failures in Mobile App and KPI Tracker
content_summary: Older guidance for resolving SMS and notification delivery issues caused by vendor outages, expired keys, or time synchronization errors in Mobile App and KPI Tracker.
content_body: If notifications are not delivered, check the vendor status page for active incidents. A common cause is an expired API key or clock synchronization issues between our servers and the third-party provider. Verify the time settings on the host machine and rotate credentials if an expiration is suspected. If the issue persists, escalate to engineering to coordinate remediation with the vendor or implement a configuration change to bypass the degraded dependency.

title: Legacy Note: Proxy and DNS Connectivity Issues for Rate Limiter and Customer Portal
content_summary: Previous troubleshooting steps for timeouts and certificate warnings caused by misconfigured firewalls or incorrect DNS settings in Rate Limiter and Customer Portal.
content_body: Users may experience timeouts or certificate warnings when accessing the Customer Portal through the Rate Limiter proxy. This was often caused by incorrect DNS configuration or firewall rules blocking specific ports. Check DNS lookup results and ensure firewall rules allow traffic on the required ports. Apply a DNS correction or update firewall rules to restore connectivity.

title: Customer Portal API Timeouts and Webhook Retry Exhaustion
content_summary: Covers API timeouts, empty responses, and exhausted webhook retries in the Customer Portal linked to third-party service failures or breaking API changes.
content_body: When the Customer Portal reports rate limit exceeded errors or empty API responses, investigate third-party service availability. Breaking API contract changes from upstream vendors can cause webhook retries to exhaust. Check vendor status pages for outages. If the issue is due to a contract change, engage the vendor or apply a workaround while the API contract fix is developed.

title: Config Manager and Load Balancer Routing Issues Due to Expired Certificates
content_summary: Addresses service unresponsiveness and certificate warnings in Config Manager and Load Balancer caused by expired certificates or firewall misconfigurations.
content_body: If the Load Balancer or Config Manager becomes unresponsive with certificate warnings, check for expired SSL/TLS certificates. Firewall misconfigurations blocking health checks can also mimic routing problems. Renew the expired certificates immediately. Review and update firewall rules to ensure traffic is correctly routed to the backend services.

title: General Guidance for Unclassified and Intermittent Issues
content_summary: Broad reference for handling tickets with symptoms like slow responses, data mismatches, or crashes where root cause is unclear or due to operator error.
content_body: Many tickets with intermittent failures or inconsistent browser behavior are closed as operator error or insufficient information. When facing slow responses or application crashes without a clear reproducible path, first verify that the configuration is supported. If the issue is user-specific, provide customer education on proper usage. Duplicate tickets should be merged, and access reviews should be completed if permissions are suspected as a factor.

title: Notification Hub Service Unresponsiveness Due to Missing Environment Variables
content_summary: Troubleshooting steps for Notification Hub failing to start or respond because of missing or incorrect environment variables and policy misconfigurations.
content_body: If the Notification Hub is unresponsive, check the deployment logs for 'environment variable missing' errors. Unsupported configurations or policy missettings often prevent the service from initializing correctly. Apply the required configuration changes to set the missing variables. If the issue stems from a policy conflict, correct the policy and educate the customer on supported configuration patterns.

title: Secret Store Deployment Failures and Rollback Procedures
content_summary: Handling deployment failures, stalled canary rollouts, or automatic rollbacks in Secret Store due to version incompatibility or incomplete migrations.
content_body: When Secret Store deployments fail or canary rollouts stall, identify if the cause is version incompatibility or an incomplete database migration. Trigger a rollback to the last stable version if data corruption is imminent. Run any necessary data repair scripts before attempting a new deployment. Ensure schema migrations are fully completed before upgrading to the next version.

title: Cache Service and Config Manager Data Mismatches from Configuration Errors
content_summary: Resolving data mismatches and config drift in Cache Service and Config Manager caused by customer configuration errors or unsupported settings.
content_body: Data mismatches in Cache Service or Config Manager often result from customer configuration errors or unsupported environment variable settings. Check for config drift alerts and compare current settings against documented requirements. Correct the configuration and restart the affected services. Update documentation if the issue was caused by ambiguous instructions, and provide customer education to prevent recurrence.

title: Diagnosing High Latency and Slow API Responses
content_summary: Guidance for investigating timeouts and high latency in API responses, often linked to capacity limitations or race conditions.
content_body: High latency and slow API responses are frequently caused by capacity limitations during peak loads or race conditions in shared resources. Monitor infrastructure metrics to identify bottlenecks. If a race condition is suspected, analyze application logs for concurrent access conflicts. Scale resources to address capacity issues or implement code fixes to resolve concurrency problems.

title: Funnel Analyzer Data Gaps Due to Upstream API Failure
content_summary: Troubleshooting steps for Funnel Analyzer when data stops flowing due to third-party dependency errors or vendor outages.
content_body: Check the vendor status page to confirm if the third-party API is currently experiencing an incident. If the API is down, Funnel Analyzer will display stale or missing data until the dependency is restored. Contact the vendor support team if the outage duration exceeds the agreed SLA. Meanwhile, verify if Config Manager has fallback caching enabled to mitigate immediate impact.

title: Status Page Calculation Errors Due to Stale Cache
content_summary: Known issue where Status Page displays incorrect uptime calculations or filtering results due to cached data not reflecting real-time metrics.
content_body: Users may report that search results or sorting filters do not match the expected data, often showing outdated status information. This is caused by aggressive caching layers that haven't yet invalidated old entries. Clearing the application cache via the admin console typically resolves the display discrepancy immediately. Note that this behavior was observed in versions prior to the v2.0 caching overhaul.

title: LDAP Connector Bulk Import Partial Failures
content_summary: Guidance on resolving partial failures during bulk account creation when using the LDAP Connector, often linked to dependency timeouts or operator errors.
content_body: If bulk imports in LDAP Connector result in duplicate accounts or stuck provisioning, check the connector logs for timeout errors indicating upstream dependency failure. Operator error, such as malformed CSV headers, is also a common root cause. Verify the source data format against the latest schema documentation. For persistent failures, engage the vendor to review backend processing queues, as older provisioning workflows lacked granular retry logic.

title: API Gateway Deployment Failure: Feature Flags Not Applying
content_summary: Troubleshooting deployment issues in API Gateway where feature flags fail to apply or breaking changes occur post-upgrade due to version incompatibility.
content_body: Verify that the API Gateway version supports the specific feature flag schema being deployed. Incompatible versions often cause migration scripts to error out or features to remain inactive. Check the deployment logs for operator errors in the configuration file syntax. If a breaking change is confirmed, initiate a rollback to the previous stable version and update the upgrade plan.

title: Attribution Engine UI Rendering and Localization Defects
content_summary: Broad reference for known UI issues in Attribution Engine, including white screens, incorrect localized text, and missing features after updates.
content_body: Users may experience white screens or inconsistent behavior across browsers, often stemming from race conditions in the rendering engine or stale cache artifacts. Localized text may appear incorrect or missing entirely due to known product limitations in previous resource bundling methods. If a feature is missing after a release, check if it was gated behind a legacy flag that has since been deprecated. These issues are typically resolved via product patches or by applying known-issue workarounds for specific browser versions.

title: Subscription Manager Upload Failures Due to Rate Limiting
content_summary: Resolving file upload failures in Subscription Manager caused by upstream rate limiting or vendor service incidents.
content_body: Check the vendor status page for any active incidents affecting the upload service. If no incident is reported, review the API response headers for rate-limiting signals (HTTP 429) from the upstream dependency. Adjust the batch size or retry interval in the Subscription Manager configuration to align with the vendor's current limits. If the issue persists, engage the vendor to request a temporary limit increase for critical migrations.

title: Networking Troubleshooting: Load Balancer and Config Manager Connectivity
content_summary: General guide for diagnosing connection resets, TLS handshake errors, and 502/504 HTTP errors related to proxy, DNS, or routing issues.
content_body: When encountering TLS handshake errors or connection resets, first verify DNS resolution for the target endpoints to rule out configuration errors. Check for HTTP 502 or 504 responses which often indicate backend health check failures or proxy timeouts. Review the Load Balancer configuration for incorrect routing rules or stale certificate bindings. If infrastructure hardware failure is suspected, initiate a failover to the secondary node and inspect the Config Manager logs for network interface errors.

title: Secret Store Query Timeouts and Replication Lag
content_summary: Addressing slow response times and high replication lag in Secret Store caused by resource exhaustion or capacity limitations.
content_body: Monitor the database metrics for signs of resource exhaustion, such as high CPU or memory usage on the primary node. If query timeouts occur alongside high replication lag, the system may be hitting a capacity limitation for the current load profile. Consider increasing the instance capacity or optimizing expensive queries. If hardware degradation is suspected, plan for an infrastructure replacement during a maintenance window.

title: MFA Manager Login Loops and Session Expiration Issues
content_summary: Resolving login loops and unexpected session expirations in MFA Manager caused by token handling bugs or operator configuration errors.
content_body: Users stuck in a login loop should clear their browser cookies to invalidate any corrupted session tokens. Check if the password reset link expiration setting aligns with the token TTL; mismatched values often cause links to expire prematurely. This behavior was frequently linked to a token expiration handling bug in earlier versions of MFA Manager. If confirmed, apply the available product patch or manually reset the user's session and token state.

title: Session Controller Token Acquisition Failures and Federation Mismatches
content_summary: Troubleshooting token acquisition errors, duplicate accounts, and federation metadata mismatches in Session Controller and LDAP Connector.
content_body: Verify that the federation metadata file in Session Controller matches the identity provider's current public keys. A mismatch here often prevents token acquisition and can lead to fallback logic creating duplicate accounts. If the IdP is experiencing an outage, token requests will fail with generic errors. For confirmed token expiration handling bugs, apply the latest product patch. If the issue is isolated to specific users, perform a token/session reset to force re-authentication.

title: Troubleshooting HTTP 500 and Empty Responses from Cache Service API
content_summary: Addresses API errors such as HTTP 500s, empty responses, and webhook failures caused by schema mismatches or breaking contract changes in the Cache Service and Load Balancer integration.
content_body: When Cache Service API calls return HTTP 500 errors or empty responses, check for recent updates to the API contract that may have introduced breaking changes. Schema mismatches often result in webhooks failing to fire or returning malformed data. Verify that your client implementation aligns with the current API specification. If the issue persists after validating the schema, apply the latest API contract fix or initiate a schema migration to reconcile the mismatch.

title: Resolving Provisioning Stuck States and Sync Failures in Permission Engine
content_summary: Covers initial sync failures, bulk import errors, and incomplete tenant setups in the Permission Engine, focusing on operator errors, dependency failures, and migration issues.
content_body: Provisioning getting stuck or synchronization delays in the Permission Engine are frequently caused by incomplete migrations or dependency failures during onboarding. Check for duplicate accounts or partial bulk import failures, which often stem from operator error or misconfigured tenant settings. Apply configuration changes to correct tenant setup and use data repair scripts to fix synchronization issues. For complex dependencies, engage the vendor or perform schema migrations to ensure the environment is properly initialized.

title: Handling Billing Engine Errors: Renewal Failures, Tax Mismatches, and Refunds
content_summary: Guidance on resolving subscription renewal failures, incorrect tax calculations, and refund delays in the Billing Engine and Fee Analyzer, often linked to third-party failures or configuration errors.
content_body: If subscriptions fail to renew or payments are stuck in processing, investigate third-party service failures and customer configuration errors in the Billing Engine. Tax calculation errors and incorrect prorations are commonly due to data quality issues or misconfigured fee analyzers. content_summary: Troubleshooting guide for Admin Console UI defects including miscalculations, blank screens, and rendering issues.
content_body: When users report wrong totals or blank screens, first check if the issue is isolated to the Admin Console or if the Chat Widget is also affected. Clearing the browser cache often resolves rendering glitches caused by stale assets. If clearing the cache does not fix the problem, it may be a race condition; attempt a hard refresh or log out and back in. For persistent accessibility warnings or missing features, verify against the current release notes to rule out known product limitations. If the issue remains unresolved, escalate to engineering with detailed screenshots and console logs.

title: Legacy Fix for Mobile App Stale Data on Re-sync
content_summary: Describes using the manual 'Force Full Sync' button in the legacy settings menu to resolve stale data and export corruption caused by idempotency failures.
content_body: If the mobile app displays stale data or corrupted exports, this was often caused by a defect in the background sync queue. To resolve this, navigate to Settings > Advanced > Sync and tap the 'Force Full Sync' button. This action manually clears the local cache and triggers a fresh download from the server. Note that the new auto-repair engine (v2.0+) now handles this automatically, so this manual step is only for legacy versions.

title: Handling Invoice Discrepancies and Chargeback Notifications
content_summary: General procedures for investigating incorrect invoices, duplicate subscription charges, and chargeback notices using the Billing Disputes Handler.
content_body: When a customer reports an incorrect invoice, overcharge, or receives a chargeback notice, first check for duplicate subscription charges or refunds that have not yet reflected in the customer's bank account. Verify if the issue stems from operator error or a product defect within the Billing Disputes Handler. If the system is functioning correctly, review subscription renewal status and engage the third-party payment vendor if a service failure is suspected. Provide customer education on pending refund timelines and escalate to engineering if a recurring billing defect is identified.

title: Closing Duplicate Ticket: Intermittent Crashes and Browser Inconsistencies
content_summary: Guidance on managing duplicate tickets involving intermittent application crashes and inconsistent browser behavior where the root cause is indeterminate.
content_body: When a user reports intermittent crashes or inconsistent behavior across browsers without providing logs, check for existing open tickets related to the same user or session ID first. If a duplicate is found, add a link to the original ticket and close the new one as a duplicate. If no existing ticket is found, request specific reproduction steps and browser versions from the customer; if they cannot provide this, close the ticket as 'insufficient information' after noting the access review was completed. Educate the customer on the value of providing detailed error context for future reports.

title: General Troubleshooting Guide: Billing Discrepancies and Payment Failures
content_summary: Overview of common billing issues including double charges, proration errors, and stuck payments, with initial triage steps for support agents.
content_body: Billing discrepancies often stem from data quality issues or operator errors in subscription configuration. First, verify the transaction status in the Chargeback Handler to rule out processing delays. If proration calculations appear incorrect, cross-reference the change date against the billing cycle snapshot. For persistent stuck payments or unreflected refunds, escalate to engineering for a data repair script or manual reconciliation. Always check if a configuration change was made recently that might have triggered a product defect.

title: OAuth Consent Records Missing from Audit Logs
content_summary: Addresses compliance reports showing incomplete data or missing consent entries due to legacy configuration gaps in Identity Vault.

This issue often stems from data quality problems where older configurations failed to persist consent tokens correctly. title: Tenant Provisioning Stuck or Delayed

Common causes include operator errors during manual onboarding or data quality issues in the source system. Use the provided data repair script to force a re-sync of the tenant state. If the issue persists, perform a manual reconciliation of the user directory and review access logs to confirm the tenant status is active.

title: Resolving HTTP 504 and TLS Handshake Errors for Secret Store
content_summary: Guidance on fixing network timeouts and TLS errors caused by proxy or DNS misconfigurations.
content_body: HTTP 504 timeouts and TLS handshake failures when accessing the Secret Store usually indicate a network configuration error or incorrect DNS settings. First, check if the client's proxy is correctly configured to allow traffic to the Secret Store endpoints. Update firewall rules if necessary to permit outbound connections on the required ports. Finally, verify DNS resolution is returning the correct IP addresses for the service to ensure connectivity.

title: Handling Data Corruption and Missing Records in OAuth Service
content_summary: Broad overview of troubleshooting corrupted exports, missing records, and referential integrity violations within the OAuth Service.

title: Notification Hub Configuration Not Propagating
content_summary: Steps to resolve issues where Notification Hub settings fail to take effect, causing service unresponsiveness.

content_summary: Basic diagnostic steps for unknown issues involving slow response times or service unresponsiveness where root cause is initially unclear.

If these steps do not resolve the issue, escalate to engineering for deeper investigation as the root cause may be insufficiently documented.

content_summary: How to identify and mitigate issues caused by downstream service failures, expired keys, or time sync problems in Chat Widget and Notification Hub.

content_summary: Guidance on resolving missing audit log entries, incomplete compliance reports, and retention policy mismatches within the Analytics Dashboard. This article covers common operator errors, known product limitations, and configuration adjustments required for regulatory compliance.

content_summary: A broad reference for handling tickets with non-specific symptoms like intermittent failures, slow responses, or data mismatches across unknown products. Provides strategies for gathering sufficient information and closing duplicate or informational requests.

title: MFA Manager and SSO Integration Module Authentication Failures
content_summary: Addresses specific MFA prompt failures, unexpected session expirations, and account lockouts in MFA Manager and SSO Integration Module. Focuses on token expiration bugs and expired certificates as primary root causes.

content_summary: Reference for resolving high replication lag, disk space exhaustion, and query timeouts in the Attribution Engine. Covers capacity limitations, resource exhaustion, and data quality issues requiring manual or scripted repair.

title: Queue Manager Autoscaling and Quota Exhaustion Troubleshooting
content_summary: Specific steps for resolving autoscaling failures, quota exceeded errors, and suspected memory leaks in the Queue Manager. Addresses insufficient capacity planning and rate limit misconfigurations.

title: Performance and Latency Issues in Load Balancer and Backend Services
content_summary: Broad troubleshooting guide for HTTP 504 timeouts, high latency, and CPU spikes associated with Load Balancer configurations. Covers third-party failures, database contention, and capacity limitations.

If latency is intermittent, investigate potential third-party service failures or database contention issues. Apply database optimization techniques to reduce query timeouts. title: Attribution Engine Storage and Database Health
content_summary: General reference for monitoring and resolving database contention, index corruption, and backup failures in the Attribution Engine. Focuses on capacity management and data integrity repair.

title: Queue Manager Resource and Quota Management
content_summary: Troubleshooting guide for autoscaling failures and quota exceeded errors in the Queue Manager. Addresses configuration mismatches and capacity planning gaps.

title: Triage and Handling for Unclassified or Duplicate Issues
content_summary: Guidance on managing tickets categorized as Unknown/Other, including duplicates, unclassified issues, and informational requests where root cause is unclear.

If the issue appears to be a configuration problem, guide the customer through standard setup validation. title: Resolving Scope and Consent Mismatches in MFA Manager
content_summary: Troubleshooting steps for access granted incorrectly, wrong tenant data visibility, or access denied errors in MFA Manager due to policy misconfiguration.

title: Handling Deployment Failures and Rollback Procedures in Deploy Manager
content_summary: Broad overview of troubleshooting deployment failures, feature flag misconfigurations, and rollback requirements in Deploy Manager.

content_summary: Troubleshooting disk usage critical alerts, replication lag, deadlocks, and query timeouts associated with the Load Balancer's backend storage.

title: Diagnosing Slow API Response and Latency in Data Pipeline and Queue Manager
content_summary: Specific steps to identify and resolve high latency, slow mobile app performance, and timeouts caused by capacity limitations or race conditions.

title: Resolving Intermittent 503 Errors and Outages in Config Manager and Cache Service
content_summary: Troubleshooting full outages, intermittent failures, and 503 errors in Config Manager and Cache Service due to bad deployments or hardware failure.

title: Managing Data Corruption and Integrity Violations in Data Export Service

title: Tax calculation errors and duplicate charges in Billing
